literal_meaning: মাঠ এবং ঘাট (ক্ষেত্র এবং নদীর তীরস্থ স্থান)
example_sentences_in_english: The floodwaters have inundated the fields and ghats everywhere.
The rain has soaked the fields and riverbanks all over.
note: This idiom evokes the imagery of Bengal's riverine and agricultural landscapes, often used in contexts of flooding or widespread occurrence.
